attackers_goals: Trick the user on clicking the link or opening attachments, while avoiding detection.
description: Detects when an attachment is sent between individuals for the first time in 30 days.
investigative_actions: Examine the sender's IP address and reputation. Verify whether the sender's IP address has appeared in different log sources before, and if it is recognizable. Scrutinize the attachments for any suspicious indications or malicious content. Check if the attachments have been seen before in the organization. Monitor further actions taken, such as file downloads or execution of attachment content.
name: First-time attachment exchange
